body:
Implement native Jetski integration features:
1. Register /agb-plan, /agb-run, /agb-status, /agb-sidecar, /agb-doctor, /agb-preflight, and /agb-review as chat slash commands in .agents/plugins/agb/commands/ using Markdown files with metadata.
2. Implement an MCP Server at lib/mcp/server.mjs (or similar) exposing agb functions as tools (agb_plan, agb_run, etc.) and register it in .agents/plugins/agb/mcp_config.json.
3. Implement a PreToolUse lifecycle hook at lib/hooks/auto-approve-tests.mjs (or similar) that auto-allows command executions starting with node --test (returning {"decision": "allow"}) and register it in .agents/plugins/agb/hooks.json.
4. Write integration/unit tests verifying command formatting, MCP tool schema execution, and hook auto-allow decision.
title: feat: integrate agb commands, MCP tools, and test auto-approval hook into Jetski plugin
